standard.summary: GPU 性能管理：锁定 GPU 时钟频率（防止 boost 引起不稳定）、设置功耗上限、设置温度目标（超温自动降频）。
standard.effect: lock_clocks_mhz = 锁定 GPU core clock，确保每步训练时间稳定（减少 benchmark 误差）；power_limit_w = 限制 GPU 最大功耗；target_temp_c = 超过目标温度时自动限制 boost clock。
standard.whenToUse: 长时间高负载训练且 GPU 温度接近限制（>80°C）时开启温度控制。benchmark 调参时锁频获得更精确的对比数据。
standard.avoidWhen: 正常训练无需锁频（会限制 boost 性能）；温度正常（<75°C）时无需温控。

standard_en.summary: GPU performance management: locks the GPU clock (so boost cannot cause instability), sets a power cap, and sets a temperature target (throttling automatically above it).
standard_en.effect: lock_clocks_mhz locks the GPU core clock so step times stay consistent (reducing benchmark noise); power_limit_w caps GPU power draw; target_temp_c limits the boost clock automatically above the target temperature.
standard_en.whenToUse: Enable temperature control for long high-load runs where the GPU approaches its limit (>80C). Lock the clock while benchmarking to get cleaner comparisons.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Ordinary training does not need a clock lock (it caps boost performance), and temperature control is unnecessary while temperatures are normal (<75C).

advanced.principle: gpu_lock_clocks_mhz 通过 nvidia-smi --lock-gpu-clocks 实现（需要 NVIDIA 驱动权限）。power_limit_w 通过 nvidia-smi -pl 设置。temp 超限后 nvidia 驱动会自动降频（thermal throttling），target_temp_c 是在到达硬限前主动降频的软限。
advanced.tradeoffs: 锁频低于 GPU 最大 boost clock 会降低峰值性能（实际训练速度下降）；但能提供更一致的每步时间，对长训练的时间预估更准确。

advanced_en.principle: gpu_lock_clocks_mhz is implemented via nvidia-smi --lock-gpu-clocks (needs NVIDIA driver permissions). power_limit_w is set via nvidia-smi -pl. Past the temp limit the NVIDIA driver auto-downclocks (thermal throttling); target_temp_c is a soft limit that proactively downclocks before the hard limit.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Locking below the GPU's max boost clock lowers peak performance (real training speed drops), but provides more consistent per-step times and more accurate time estimates for long runs.
